coverage.row: Parity 1: intrinsic values round-trip parent->child->parent with Node's types
Parity 2: class instances and null-prototype objects arrive as plain Object; non-enumerable and symbol keys are gone; an own getter runs exactly once
Parity 3: Errors keep class, message, stack and cause; a subclass, a custom name and AggregateError arrive as Error; an own name 'TypeError' arrives as TypeError

Parity 4: views keep type and exactly their bytes; own props drop; a subclass becomes Uint8Array; views arrive independent; the same view twice stays one object; a view as a Map key round-trips; a SAB view arrives as an unshared copy
Parity 5: Buffer.from/alloc, a nested Buffer and an own-constructor Buffer arrive as Buffer both ways, with child-originated Map/Set/Date, RangeError+cause, a SAB view, two views and a circular task
Parity 6: vitest 4.1.11 forks-pool frames (start, fetch request, reply r: undefined, onCollected circular + null-proto meta, testfileFinished)

Parity 7: refusals on the parent and child side (ERR_MISSING_ARGS, ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE with Received text, plain Error '<x> could not be cloned.' without code, getter order, throwing getter, channel usable)
Parity 8: an echo child held only by process.on('message') is alive and connected after 300 ms idle and exits 0 after the parent disconnects
Parity 9: serialization 'bogus'/'JSON'/1/null -> TypeError ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE with Node's message in fork and ('bogus') in a plain spawn; spawn advanced without IPC runs normally

Parity 10: same-realm route: the copy is fixed at send(); types round-trip; a nested function is refused with a plain Error; a child Buffer arrives as Buffer; child disconnect -> 'disconnect' and exit 0

Parity 11: default JSON, parent and child side, Worker and same-realm routes: top-level undefined -> ERR_MISSING_ARGS; anonymous and named function, symbol and bigint -> ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE with Node's Received text; the child exits 0
Fault peer death: messages posted before a natural end or a timer crash are delivered in order, then 'disconnect', then 'exit' 0/1; send() after exit returns false; nothing replayed
Fault concurrent-same-key: writes after send() to the object, a SAB view and a Buffer are invisible to the peer

Fault observable-order: a refused send between two accepted sends throws synchronously, posts nothing, and the next messages arrive in order; named throws: the ceiling test and the browser-unit ceiling 'received' row
Fault sibling-drift: one codec gives identical rows at the parent Worker, child Worker and same-realm sites and in Chromium; the JSON sites share the top-level text
Fault corrupt-input: a child bundle older than the launch is refused before user entry by protocol mismatch; never a JSON child on an advanced parent
